---
name: Feature / API request
about: Suggest a new endpoint, field, or doc-side improvement.
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Use case**
What are you trying to accomplish? What's blocking you today?

**Proposal**
What you'd like to see — endpoint name, fields, response shape, or a
new doc section.

**Workaround (if any)**
How you're solving this today (polling, scraping, manual portal use).

**Type**
- [ ] New API endpoint (server-side change — will be triaged to the
      product team)
- [ ] Existing endpoint, new field
- [ ] Webhook event
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Example SDK addition (language: ____)

**Anything else?**
Constraints, similar APIs that do this well, links to relevant
specifications.
